prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a stepper motor placed on a light wooden tabletop, with its metallic front plate and central shaft facing the camera. The motor is rectangular, with a matte black body and a silver faceplate secured by four visible screws. Several multicolored wires extend from the back of the motor, trailing out of focus toward the background, where blurred electronic components and circuit boards are partially visible, suggesting a workshop or laboratory setting. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the metallic textures of the motor. The color palette is muted, dominated by cool grays, blacks, and the pale beige of the tabletop, with subtle pops of color from the wires. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the motor sharply in focus while the background elements are softly blurred, creating a sense of depth and drawing attention to the mechanical details. The overall style is documentary and technical, with a clean, precise aesthetic that emphasizes the subject’s industrial design and functionality.
